name: Browser
description: The shared ZenX browser and an explicitly connected external browser, available together with independent targets and tool approvals.
mainDocument: Use Browser for bounded tab inspection and interaction. Inspect coverage: a full response is a self-contained bounded view, not necessarily the whole page. Follow nextCursor with browser_workspace_inspect cursor to read the same immutable capture without renewing its observationId; native omissions remain explicit. Stable targetId values only act with the latest observationId and are revalidated. Prefer observe:true on actions. Pass baseObservationId only while retaining that first-page baseline (and applied targetChanges); omitted base or full:true resynchronizes, including after context compaction. Diffs use added/updated/removedFromView and optional complete order, with visibleText replaced only when present; removedFromView never proves DOM deletion. Cursor pages do not change the first-page diff baseline. Discard all prior continuation pages when adopting a new observation or first-page diff; use the new nextCursor to read its tails. If actionCompleted:true includes observationError, inspect again without repeating the completed action. Shared Workspace tabs expose control and mutationsRequireObservation. Human control blocks Agent mutations; only the user can return control. After takeover, every mutation, including browser_workspace_navigate/browser_workspace_close, must carry the latest observationId from a new browser_workspace_inspect after return. In-flight/unknown actions are not cancelled; never replay them automatically. Browser backends coexist: browser_workspace_* uses the shared Workspace browser; browser_connected_* uses only the explicitly enabled external connection. Start with each backend's list_tabs using a sessionId. Results identify backendId. Pass returned tabId, observationId, targetId and cursor unchanged to tools in the same namespace; cross-backend references reject. An unavailable external connection never redirects to the Workspace browser. Closing a connected tab/session only detaches ZenX and leaves the user's page open. Approvals for one tool namespace do not approve the other. Only one external browser connection is supported at a time; disconnect it explicitly before connecting another.

permissions.title: Inspect browser tabs
permissions.description: List tabs and inspect bounded visible text and interactive targets.

permissions.title: Open and navigate pages
permissions.description: Open URLs or navigate an explicitly targeted ZenX browser tab.

permissions.title: Interact with pages
permissions.description: Click, type, or select an option in an explicitly targeted visible page element, scroll the page viewport, or dispatch bounded coordinate/key input to the observed tab.

tools.name: browser_workspace_list_tabs
tools.description: [Workspace browser] List bounded metadata for tabs in one explicit ZenX browser session. Cookies, storage, headers, and history are never returned.

tools.name: browser_workspace_open
tools.description: [Workspace browser] Open an HTTP(S) URL in a shared Thread-owned Workspace tab visible to the user; this does not connect an external browser.

observe.description: Return a fresh observation after the action; prefer true to avoid a separate browser_workspace_inspect call. Surviving DOM nodes retain targetId, but observationId is always fresh. baseObservationId may request a diff of the retained first page. Defaults to false.

baseObservationId.description: Request a diff only when you still retain that observation's full first-page baseline (or have applied its diffs). Omit after context compaction or lost context to receive a self-contained full view.

full.description: Force a new self-contained full bounded view. This does not mean the entire page/window was captured; follow nextCursor and inspect coverage.

tools.name: browser_workspace_navigate
tools.description: [Workspace browser] Navigate one explicit ZenX browser session/tab target to an http(s) URL.

observationId.description: Required for a shared Workspace tab after human takeover: pass its latest browser_workspace_inspect observationId. Missing, stale, or pre-takeover references reject. Other backends do not require this field.

tools.name: browser_workspace_inspect
tools.description: [Workspace browser] Inspect one tab, or use nextCursor to read more of its exact captured snapshot. Coverage distinguishes unread captured data from native omissions. Omit baseObservationId or set full:true for a self-contained first page; a retained matching base allows a smaller diff. Target IDs are stable only for surviving observed DOM nodes; actions require the fresh observationId.

full.description: Force a new self-contained full bounded view. This does not mean the entire page/window was captured; follow nextCursor and inspect coverage.

tools.name: browser_workspace_pointer_click
tools.description: [Workspace browser] Click CSS viewport coordinates in the exact observed browser tab without requesting window activation. Requires a real screenshot and inputViewport from the latest inspection. Convert screenshot pixels with x * inputViewport.width / screenshot.width and likewise y. No frames, dragging, OS input or automatic foreground fallback. Detected page, viewport, focus, or user input changes reject. Open shadow roots resolve within bounded limits; ordinary div/span containers remain supported after exact-node metadata checks, while known closed or unresolved shadow surfaces reject locally. Ordinary tab input stays targeted without selecting an active tab. Trusted input can trigger site dialogs or popups; identifiable native pickers reject and native UI requires human control, never global input or forced activation. Unknown input is never replayed.

tools.description: [Workspace browser] Press one named unmodified key in the exact browser tab's already-focused observed element, without requesting window activation. Requires focusedInputAvailable and a fresh inspection; never selects a current tab or focuses an element implicitly. Open shadow focus resolves to its real node; ordinary focused contenteditable containers remain supported after exact-node metadata checks, while known closed or unresolved shadow focus is unavailable. Trusted input can trigger site dialogs or popups; identifiable native pickers reject and native UI requires human control, never global input or forced activation. Unknown input is never replayed.
